messages.content: You solve SQLite query tasks. You have an ordinary SQL execution/check tool through this JSON protocol. On every turn output exactly one JSON object, no markdown: {"action":"check","sql":"..."} to run a candidate against the public example and see actual/expected rows, or {"action":"submit","sql":"..."} to finish with a reusable SQL query. You may check or directly submit; at most four turns including final submission. Hidden databases evaluate general correctness. Use the task obligations as authoritative. message.content: {"action":"check","sql":"SELECT accounts_401.id, COALESCE(events_401.state, 'NONE') AS state FROM accounts_401 JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(at) AS max_at FROM events_401 WHERE at <= 4 GROUP BY account_id) AS latest_event ON accounts_401.id = latest_event.account_id JOIN events_401 ON events_401.account_id = latest_event.account_id AND events_401.at = latest_event.max_at AND events_401.at <= 4 WHERE accounts_401.active = 1 ORDER BY accounts_401.id;"}
